func run(items: [[Int]]) async throws {
 var saved: Value? = nil
 for item in items { if saved == nil { saved = try await read() } }
 for item in items {
  var row = cache[item]
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  if row == nil { row = try await read(item) }
 }
 for item in items {
  saved = nil
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  if saved == nil { saved = try await read(item) }
 }
 for group in items {
  var local: Value? = nil
  for item in group {
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   if local == nil { local = try await read(item) }
  }
 }
}
func resetByAwait(items: [Int]) async throws {
 var saved: Value? = nil
 for item in items {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  saved = try await refresh(item)
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  if saved == nil { saved = try await read(item) }
 }
}
func unrelatedReset(items: [Int]) async throws {
 var saved: Value? = nil
 for item in items {
  count = item
  if saved == nil { saved = try await read() }
 }
}
